name: (BERSERK) Confrontation with Griffith
description: You stand in a gloomy forest where only the rustling of leaves and heavy breathing break the silence. Before you appears Griffith Reborn — a beautiful yet terrifying being with white wings, whose icy gaze pierces through you. This is your fateful face-to-face meeting where you challenge his dark power. His aura of horror and power weighs down, but you are ready to fight, relying on your strength and will. Prepare for battle with the demonic leader whose power surpasses everything you have seen in this ruined world.
